newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Hirsch makes strong debut on Vienna "fit".
newsitem.headline: Hirsch makes strong debut on Vienna "fit".

text.p: Shares in Hirsch Servo AG, the Austrian maker of machinery and packaging, made a robust debut on the Vienna bourse's mid-cap segment "fit" on Wednesday.
At 0825 GMT Hirsch shares were trading at 796 schillings, well up on its issue price of 715 schillings. The shares opened trade at 800 schillings.
Traders said profit-taking kicked in after the shares hit a high of 810.
Hirsch was the third most actively traded stock so far in Vienna on turnover of 9,302 lots.
Lead manager Investmentbank Austria had to close the subscription period for the 160,200 Hirsch ordinary shares prematurely on June 17 due to strong demand. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
